title: Study abroad with FMA Overseas — universities that accept a Bloom band
meta_description: The universities that have admitted Bloom students, the English requirement each department actually enforces, and how our FMA Overseas partnership handles your application.

props.eyebrow: Study abroad · in partnership with FMA Overseas
props.heading: A band is not the goal. The offer letter is.
props.body: Getting Band 7 is half the journey. Turning it into a place at a university abroad — the application, the credential check, the visa, the accommodation — is the other half. That is what FMA Overseas does, and Bloom students go straight through to them.

lockup.note: Your Bloom score report transfers directly into an FMA Overseas application file. One team, one set of documents, no repeating yourself.

items.title: Reach your band
items.body: Bloom gets you to the score your target university requires — including any per-skill minimum, which is where most applications actually fail.

items.title: Shortlist with FMA
items.body: An FMA Overseas counsellor matches your band, transcript and budget against real entry requirements and tells you where you will get in.

items.title: Apply and get offers
items.body: Applications, statements of purpose, credential evaluation and reference chasing, handled for you. Multiple offers, not one hopeful punt.

items.title: Visa and finance
items.body: Student visa filing, financial documentation, tuition deposits and the interview preparation that decides a UKVI or SEVIS outcome.

items.title: Arrive settled
items.body: Accommodation, airport pickup, bank account, registration and a Bloom alumni contact already studying on your campus.

checklist.title: Everything between your result and your first lecture.

items.title: Requirement checking before you sit
items.body: We confirm the exact overall and per-skill minimum your shortlist demands, so you do not pass the test and still miss the offer.

items.title: Credential evaluation
items.body: Degree and transcript assessment for the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, Germany and Italy — including ECTS conversion.

items.title: Pathway and foundation routes
items.body: If your band is not there yet, a pre-sessional English or foundation route that still leads to the same degree.

items.title: Scholarship and funding search
items.body: Merit awards, regional bursaries and assistantships matched to your profile — most students never find these alone.

items.title: Visa filing and interview prep
items.body: Financial evidence, the credibility interview, and the English-language part of the visa rules that changes most often.

items.title: One file, both teams
items.body: Your Bloom band history, mock reports and score conversions attach to your FMA application automatically.

props.cta_note: Free consultation for every Bloom student, whatever your current band.

props.heading: Where a Bloom band actually gets you.
props.lead: Every university below has admitted a Bloom student. The English requirement shown is the one the department actually enforces — including the per-skill minimum, which is what catches most applicants out.

universities.name: University of Manchester
universities.note: Strong pathway for our Plus and Premium students.

universities.name: King's College London
universities.note: Writing minimum is the usual blocker — plan for a 7.0 writing target.

universities.name: UNSW Sydney
universities.note: Three intakes a year gives useful flexibility if a retake is needed.

universities.name: University of Toronto
universities.note: Overall 7.0 with no per-skill rule — a strong listening score can carry writing.

universities.name: TU Delft
universities.note: No tuition-fee loan for non-EU; plan finances early.

universities.name: Trinity College Dublin
universities.note: Two-year post-study work visa makes this popular with our cohort.

universities.name: University of Pavia
universities.note: IMAT route — prepared jointly with Future MedsAcademy.

universities.name: RWTH Aachen
universities.note: No tuition fees; blocked account required for the visa.

globe.heading: The school for English that is accepted all over the globe.
globe.body: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, Duolingo, Cambridge and OET are recognised by more than 12,000 institutions, every major immigration authority and every medical regulator we work with. You prepare once at Bloom; the score opens doors on four continents.

props.heading: Students who made it there.
props.lead: Photographs sent back by Bloom students after they arrived — the reason any of this matters.
